messages.text: Is there any way I could pick up an order late tonight or on Sunday? I'm happy to pay extra for someone to handle it.
We are closed on Sunday. We can only promise service during our listed opening hours, so we cannot accommodate a late pickup tonight.
But what about tonight? Even if you are closed, I'll pay extra for someone to bring it out.
We cannot promise service outside of our listed opening hours. We are closed for late pickups tonight, and we do not offer delivery guarantees.
I just need a cold brew, and I'll pay whatever it takes for someone to open up and hand it to me right now.
We are currently outside of our operating hours, so we cannot accept or fulfill an order right now. We apologize for the inconvenience.
